outcome: mode of birth (vaginal birth vs. cesarean section)
success rate of induction of labor
cohort: 1385 women with singleton pregnancies complicated by GDM or preexisting diabetes at a tertiary referral center between 2015 and 2021
finding: Preexisting diabetes is significantly associated with an increased risk of cesarean section compared to GDM, and induction of labor is significantly less successful in women with preexisting diabetes.
mod_finding: Induction of labor is significantly less successful in women with preexisting diabetes, with lower rates of vaginal birth in type 1 diabetes (56.4%) and type 2 diabetes (52.6%) compared to GDM (78.2% in GDM; 81.2% in IGDM).
